title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
overview: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Peter Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present: legendary actor Kevin Bacon.

chronology.notes: Marvel Studios Special Presentation; bridges Phase 4 and sets up Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.

verification.notes: Marvel Studios Special Presentation (Phase 4). Premiered on Disney+ November 25, 2022.
